title: Damn, Unreal + Codex is a Godsent!
author: CosmicEmotion
selftext:
Just set it up a couple of hours ago and I'm already so far ahead in the project. Literally 3 months of work in a couple of hours! This is AMAZING! :)

  
Thank you God for AI! 😄

comments.author: Mental-Frosting-7752
comments.body: What do you use on unreal engine?

replies.author: CosmicEmotion
replies.body:
I set up a (3D) city for background, created a Dialogue System for my Visual novel game and avatars. Now I'm writing dialogue! Straight to the point! :)

This is indescribably awesome! 😄

comments.author: proximalcoast
comments.body:
I’m finding it to be a real slog. I mean it works, sure, but I’ve run into execution problems all along the way. I think for what you describe as the core game loop has a lot more to do with your initial successes than the agent.

But all that to say: congrats. I’m happy for you. Nice.
